column1: # sync_manifest.tsv — declares which files in this repo (dyna-clust-predict,
# the "main" project) should be kept in sync with which sibling repos.
# Siblings are dataset-specific forks that share the core R pipeline logic
# but diverge intentionally on dataset-specific scripts, configs, and (for
# AM) subset.R/check_annotations.R, which encode AM-specific sampling and
# correction logic. See README.md "Cross-repo harmonisation" for the full
# rationale and how this manifest is used (tools/check_drift.sh locally,
# .github/workflows/sync-to-siblings.yml on push to main).
# Format: tab-separated, 3 columns, no header row below this comment block.
#   path   -- repo-relative path of a file to sync (not a directory)
#   am     -- yes/no: does this file sync to dyna-clust-predict-am
#   ecm    -- yes/no: does this file sync to dyna-clust-predict-ecm
# Only files listed here are ever touched by the sync tooling. Anything not
# listed (scripts/*.sh, README.md, environment.yml, data/, config/, etc.) is
# left entirely alone in every sibling, since those are dataset-specific by
# design.
R/utils.R
R/predict.R
R/reformat.R
R/compute_sim.R
R/dereplicate_lca.R
R/consolidate_cutoffs.R
R/subset.R
R/check_annotations.R
tests/consolidate_cutoffs/run_test.R
tests/reformat/run_test.R
tests/test_load_classification_quoting.R
